Applied econometrics and financial econometrics, for analyzing real-world data and modeling market uncertainty.

## Courses

- **Econometrics (Wooldridge)** — OLS, inference, instrumental variables, panel data. *(coming soon)*
- **Financial Econometrics** — modeling returns, risk, volatility. *(coming soon)*
- **Time Series** — stationarity, ARIMA, VAR, cointegration, GARCH. *(coming soon)*
